## Change and reason

## Verification

Commands, OS/architecture, results and cleanup. Mark untested platforms explicitly.

- [ ] Added a regression for behavior changes, or explained why none is needed.
- [ ] Ran static checks; application/integration checks ran in a disposable VM.
- [ ] Preserved original audio, settings, pending-save recovery and owned-process cleanup.
- [ ] Updated relevant docs/screenshots and stated their fixture/real-app scope.
- [ ] No secrets, personal paths, live bearer URLs, model weights, generated music or private logs.
- [ ] No new dependency without explaining its necessity and license.
